playstyle: Defensive Mishima with the strongest punishment kit in the game (Wavu). Block, punish everything hard, and threaten the Wind God Fist and hellsweep from a crouch dash. In Heat he becomes Devil Kazuya and can do the EWGF easily. Like all Mishimas he is weak to sidesteps to his left.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: Wind God Fist, Thunder God Fist, hellsweep and Hell Lancer come from here.

stances.name: Devil Kazuya
stances.note: Devil Transformation: new moves and an easier EWGF (Wavu).

keyMoves: i10 punish string; the last hit is -17 on block.
Block and punish the last hit.
Acute Pain: i12 mid, -13 on block, launches on hit (+13a).
Slaughter Hook: i18 Heat Engager string, +0c on block.
To keep the turn and start Heat.
Against crouchers on the second hit.
Right Splits Kick: i19 mid, +4c on block.
Wind God Fist: i11 high, -10 on block; the EWGF is +5.
Fast launcher, punisher and whiff punisher.
Practise the input until it is automatic.
Twin Pistons: i13 while-standing launcher, -12 on block.
After lows that are -13 or worse.
Abolishing Fist: i14 homing mid, launches on counter hit (+59a).
i11 string that wall-splats (Wavu: i11 splat). -14 on block.
A fast punish near the wall.
Hellsweep: i16 low, -23 on block, launches on counter hit.
Once they respect the Wind God Fist.
The low half of his mix-up.
Stature Smash: i20 low, -12 on block, +17g on counter hit.
Devil Fist: i16 mid Heat Engager, -9 on block.
To start Heat and whiff punish.
i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Launch BnB: 3,1,4 df+1,df+2 T! 3,1~df~3
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as f,F+3 (Left Splits Kick).
mistakes: Delaying 3,1,4: start it as soon as they are in the air.
